plotEn:
Haunted (French: Hantée) is a Canadian fantasy comedy film, directed by Rafaël Ouellet and released in 2026. The film stars Jade Brind'Amour as Mathilde, a teenage girl who moves to rural Quebec with her parents Louis (François Létourneau) and Judith (Evelyne Brochu); discovering that their new home is haunted, she forges an unlikely friendship with Isabeau (Virginie Fortin), the 19th-century ghost who inhabits the building.
The cast also includes Emma Bao Linh, Mathilde Boucher, Oscar Desgagnés
